name: Michael Schmidt-Ruthenbeck Bros.
current_role: Co-owner (with brother Rainer) of the family stake in retailer Metro AG, held via the Meridian Stiftung structure
profile: Michael Schmidt-Ruthenbeck (b. 1942) and his brother Rainer are sons of Wilhelm Schmidt-Ruthenbeck, who co-founded the German cash-and-carry wholesaler Metro in 1963/64. The family has held a large minority stake in Metro AG (about 16% around 2011), controlled through the Meridian Foundation vehicle, and is based in Duisburg. Listing is a combined entry for the brothers.
interesting_fact: The Schmidt-Ruthenbeck family holding was a key swing shareholder during Czech investor Daniel Kretinsky's 2019-2020 push for control of Metro AG.
deep_cut_fact: The Karl Schmidt family of Duisburg merchants founded Stiftung Mercator in 1996 and named it after the cartographer Gerhard Mercator, who lived in Duisburg for decades; it is now one of Germany's largest private foundations, with a climate-resilient-society programme.
notes: Very private family; no personal web/social presence found. No death reported, but no recent public appearance found either (born 1942). The only institutional route is the family's Stiftung Mercator (Essen), which is not a personal office. Forbes entry dates from 1997.

name: Paul Georges Despature
current_role: Chairman of Edify (Despature family investment company); former chairman of Somfy's management board (1983-2014)
profile: Paul-Georges Despature is the patriarch of the French Despature family, which controls Somfy, the Cluses-based maker of motors and automation for blinds, shutters and gates. He ran Somfy as chairman of its management board from 1983 until the end of 2014, then moved to head the family investment arm Edify. His son Jean Guillaume Despature now chairs Somfy, which the family took private in 2022-23.
interesting_fact: The Despature family, which already owned the thermal-underwear brand Damart, bought Somfy in 1984 as a diversification into summer-season products; Somfy has since become a world leader in motorised blinds and the connected home.
deep_cut_fact: The name SOMFY is an acronym for 'Société d'Outillage et Mécanique du FaucignY', a 1969 spin-off of the Cluses precision-machining firm Carpano & Pons in the Arve valley, a region known for Swiss-watch part-making.

public_contacts.value: Agence Shan (Somfy press agency), 30 rue des Mathurins, 75008 Paris

notes: Low public profile; no personal social accounts found. Edify role per Somfy's December 2014 announcement (https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/AMF/ECO/2014/12/FCECO035465_20141222.pdf); check whether he still holds it. Somfy press route is the corporate one, not a personal office.

name: Leonard Schleifer
current_role: Co-founder, Board Co-Chair, President and CEO, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ: REGN)
profile: Leonard Schleifer was a young neurologist and assistant professor at Cornell when he founded Regeneron in 1988, recruiting George Yancopoulos as co-founder. He took it public in 1991 and still runs the Tarrytown, NY company, which has 12 FDA-approved medicines, including the blockbuster eye drug Eylea and Dupixent (with Sanofi). He owns about 2% of the stock.
interesting_fact: The company name means 'regenerating neurons', with 'gene' hidden in the middle; the idea was first sketched on a napkin.
deep_cut_fact: At the urging of his Queens high-school math teacher, Schleifer entered the 1970 Westinghouse Science Talent Search, the competition Regeneron itself now sponsors as the Regeneron Science Talent Search.
notes: Active public figure who speaks regularly on drug pricing and science-led management. The best route is Regeneron corporate communications. Press and IR names come from 2026 earnings releases; check the latest release for current contacts.

name: Lucio Tan
current_role: Founder and Chairman, LT Group Inc. (tobacco, spirits, beer, banking, property; parent links to Philippine Airlines)
profile: Born in China and raised in the Philippines, Lucio Tan co-founded Fortune Tobacco in 1966 and built it into LT Group, with interests in tobacco (PMFTC), Tanduay rum, Asia Brewery (1982), Philippine National Bank and property. He also controls flag carrier Philippine Airlines through PAL Holdings. In 2023 his grandson Lucio Tan III became president of LT Group and PAL Holdings.
interesting_fact: Before becoming a tycoon he worked as a janitor in a tobacco factory while studying chemical engineering at Far Eastern University, and was later promoted to tobacco 'cook' mixing blends.
deep_cut_fact: Tan says he went to school barefoot as a child; decades later he was expanding into nickel mining to ride the EV-battery-driven nickel boom.
notes: In his 90s (born 1933/34); day-to-day leadership is moving to grandson Lucio Tan III. Enjoys riding helicopters (Forbes). LT Group IR is named in PSE Edge disclosures (https://edge.pse.com.ph/downloadHtml.do?file_id=1987230), but no clean email was verified. Very limited personal media presence.
